title: Graphox Configuration
description: Configuration for Graphox, a high-performance GraphQL toolset.

projects.description: Project configurations. Projects are matched in order; the first matching project is used for each file.

schema_types.description: Generate standalone TypeScript types from the schema without operations.

scalars.description: Map GraphQL scalar types to TypeScript types.

ignore_deprecations.description: Suppress warnings for deprecated fields or types globally.

watch_all_files.description: Whether to watch all workspace files for changes. If false, only GraphQL files are watched.

lsp_automatic_codegen.description: Whether to automatically run codegen on file changes in the LSP.

lsp_codegen_throttle_ms.description: Throttle automatic codegen in the LSP (ms).

codegen_watch_debounce_ms.description: Debounce file changes in watch mode (ms).

enable_schema_cache.description: Enable two-tier schema cache for better performance.

allow_no_documents.description: Allow a project whose include/documents pattern matches no files. When false, graphox check and graphox codegen fail on such a project instead of exiting cleanly without having done anything. Can be overridden per project.

codegen.description: Codegen configuration. Set to false to disable codegen globally.

ProjectConfig.$comment: include is the documented spelling, but the parser falls back to the legacy documents, so requiring include outright would reject configs that load fine.

schema.description: Single schema file path or an array of paths for multi-file schemas.

include.description: Glob pattern(s) for GraphQL operations to include in this project.

exclude.description: Glob pattern(s) for files to exclude from this project.

allow_no_documents.description: Overrides the top-level allow_no_documents for this project.

output_dir.description: Directory where generated files will be placed.

import.description: The import path used by other projects to reference fragments from this project.

imports.description: Import paths of other projects whose fragments this project may use. A fragment is only accessible across projects when the defining project's import appears here.

subgraphs.description: Directory of subgraph schemas. Every .graphql file in it is loaded as a subgraph named after the file.

subgraph_owners.description: Owner of each subgraph, keyed by the subgraph's file name without its extension.

codegen.description: Codegen configuration for this project. Set to false to disable codegen.

possible_types.description: Path to generate possibleTypes introspection data for Apollo Client's InMemoryCache.

type_policies.description: Path to generate strict TypeScript types for Apollo Client TypePolicies.

output.description: File path where schema types will be generated.

import.description: How generated files import these types.

possible_types.description: Path to generate possibleTypes introspection data for Apollo Client.

type_policies.description: Path to generate Apollo Client TypePolicies.

required_fields.description: Fields that must be selected. Keyed by field name, or by type name for rules that apply only within that type.

forbidden_fields.description: Fields that must not be selected. Keyed by field name, or by type name for rules that apply only within that type.

unique_operation_name.description: Enforce unique names for all operations across the project. Reported as an error unless a severity is given.

no_duplicate_fields.description: Prevent selecting the same field multiple times in a single selection set. Reported as an error unless a severity is given.

no_unused_fragments.description: Identify and report fragments that are defined but not used. Reported as a warning unless a severity is given.

repeated_selections.description: Report selections that recur across the workspace. Configured as a list so each kind of finding gets its own thresholds and severity.

kind.description: matches_fragment: a selection that is exactly a fragment that already exists. extends_fragment: a selection containing a fragment's fields plus more. new_fragment: a group of fields that recurs with no fragment for it.

min_fields.description: Members a selection must share to be reported. Fields that required_fields mandates do not count. Defaults to 3 for matches_fragment, 4 for extends_fragment and 6 for new_fragment.

min_uses.description: Distinct definitions that must share a group. Only applies to new_fragment: one selection re-inlining an existing fragment is already a finding.

severity.description: Defaults to error for matches_fragment, warning for extends_fragment and info for new_fragment.

ignore_types.description: GraphQL type names this entry does not report on.

Severity.description: How a rule reports its violations. Which levels end the run non-zero is decided separately, by `graphox check --fail-on`.

Rule.description: A rule that is either on or off, optionally with a severity.

oneOf.description: Enables the rule and sets its severity.

enabled.description: Whether the rule applies. Defaults to true, so an entry naming only a severity is an opt-in.

FieldRuleEntry.description: A rule for the named field, or, when the name is a type, a map of that type's fields to their rules.
FieldRuleEntry.$comment: anyOf rather than oneOf: { enabled: true } is both a valid rule and a valid one-entry type, so the forms genuinely overlap and oneOf would reject it for matching twice. The bare string form is absent on purpose — the parser only reads a value as a rule when it is a boolean, an array, or an object with enabled, so a string here is ignored. It does work one level down, inside a type.

anyOf.description: Whether the rule applies to every operation type.
The operation types the rule applies to: query, mutation or subscription. Matched case-insensitively.
Field rules scoped to this type.

FieldRule.description: A rule for a single field.

oneOf.description: Whether the rule applies to every operation type.
A single operation type the rule applies to: query, mutation or subscription. Matched case-insensitively.
The operation types the rule applies to: query, mutation or subscription. Matched case-insensitively.

enabled.description: Whether the rule applies, or the operation types it applies to.

severity.description: Overrides this rule's default severity, which is error.

entrypoint_name.description: Filename for the generated root entrypoint without extension.

document_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated document constant.

omit_operation_suffix_in_document_name.description: Use raw operation names for generated document constants, e.g. PlaylistTracksDocument instead of PlaylistTracksQueryDocument.

variables_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated variables type.

fragment_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated fragment type.

fragment_document_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated fragment document constant.

query_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated query type.

mutation_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated mutation type.

subscription_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated subscription type.

react_apollo_hooks.description: Generate Apollo React hook wrappers and hook result aliases for operations.

apollo_react_common_import_from.description: Module specifier used for Apollo React common types like QueryResult and MutationResult.

apollo_react_hooks_import_from.description: Module specifier used for Apollo React hooks like useQuery and useMutation.

fragment_masking.description: Enable fragment masking to prevent fragment fields from 'leaking' into parent operation types.

unmask_function_name.description: Custom function name for unmasking fragment data.

generate_ast_for_fragments.description: Generate and reuse AST nodes for fragments to reduce bundle sizes.

re_exports.description: Re-export all operation and fragment types/documents from the root graphql.ts file.

prune_orphans.description: Delete generated files whose source document no longer exists or no longer contains GraphQL, instead of leaving them behind until the next `codegen --clean`.

default_scalar_type.description: Default type for scalars not defined in 'scalars' mapping.

schema_import.description: The import path used in generated operation files to reference schema types.

nullable_fields_as_optional.description: Generate nullable fields as optional properties (with '?') in TypeScript interfaces.

graphql_tag_fallback.description: Use graphql-tag as a fallback for the generated graphql function. Useful for development when not all literals are codegen yet.

merge_union_types.description: Whether to merge union members with the same selection set into a single object type with a union __typename. Defaults to false for better type narrowing, but can be set to true for more concise types.

threshold_ms.description: Only trace requests exceeding this threshold in milliseconds.
